lines.speaker: Baby Trunks
lines.text: (Crying)

lines.speaker: Bulma
lines.text: Ugh... oh wow... pretty sure I was about to be a wish there.

lines.speaker: Bulma
lines.text: OH GOD THE BABY!!

lines.speaker: Bulma
lines.text: Uhh, there you are.

lines.speaker: Bulma
lines.text: Aww, don't worry, Trunkie! It was just an explosion!

lines.speaker: Bulma
lines.text: You'll get used to those. Those happen a lot around Mommy.

lines.speaker: Trunks
lines.text: I could have sworn I saw somebody else in the car with you.

lines.speaker: Bulma
lines.text: Hmm?

lines.speaker: Yajirobe
lines.text: "Hey, Yajirobe!"

lines.speaker: Yajirobe
lines.text: "What is it, Korin?"

lines.speaker: Yajirobe
lines.text: "Why don't you go help out the gang?"

lines.speaker: Yajirobe
lines.text: "Oh sure, Korin. Why not? What's the worst that could happen?"

lines.speaker: Yajirobe
lines.text: ...I got a rock up my butt.

lines.speaker: Vegeta
lines.text: Oh, you've gotta be kidding me! He got away AGAIN!?

lines.speaker: Vegeta
lines.text: And not a nut, or bolt to be found!

lines.speaker: Vegeta
lines.text: NOT THAT YOU HAD ANY NUTS TO BEGIN WITH!

lines.speaker: Trunks
lines.text: Hurrh!

lines.speaker: Trunks
lines.text: Look. I don't mean to tell you how to be a father, but why didn't you try and save your wife and son?

lines.speaker: Vegeta
lines.text: My what and my son?

lines.speaker: Trunks
lines.text: Wait! You mean you two never got married?

lines.speaker: Vegeta
lines.text: What is that? Some kind of food?

lines.speaker: Trunks
lines.text: No, just... listen. When two people love each other--

lines.speaker: Vegeta
lines.text: Oh wow, I'm just f***ing with you. My God. Who doesn't know what marriage is?

lines.speaker: Vegeta
lines.text: Also - love each other? Making a lot of assumptions here.

lines.speaker: Trunks
lines.text: Grrrh...!

lines.speaker: Bulma
lines.text: Soo... I thought you guys were fighting Androids.

lines.speaker: Bulma
lines.text: Why was Dr. Gero here?
Group gasp, suspenseful music!

lines.speaker: Krillin
lines.text: ...Who dat?

lines.speaker: Bulma
lines.text: Scientist, worked for the Red Ribbon Army... adequate with robotics.

lines.speaker: Krillin
lines.text: Ohhhh!

lines.speaker: Krillin
lines.text: Hey, Mr. Can't Say! You may want to hear this!

lines.speaker: Vegeta
lines.text: *You f***ing failure*!

lines.speaker: Trunks
lines.text: Hold on a second! I--

lines.speaker: Vegeta
lines.text: You told us: Two Androids, May 12th, 10:00 AM, South City!

lines.speaker: Trunks
lines.text: Well, nine miles off o--

lines.speaker: Vegeta
lines.text: And what happens?

lines.speaker: Vegeta
lines.text: We waste our time on the WRONG F***ING ANDROIDS!

lines.speaker: Trunks
lines.text: Look! I was... uh, how old is that baby?

lines.speaker: Bulma
lines.text: 'Bout ten months.

lines.speaker: Trunks
lines.text: Ten months old at the time!

lines.speaker: Vegeta
lines.text: How 'bout next time you come back to give someone a heads-up, YOU GIVE 'EM A GODDAMN PHOTO!

lines.speaker: Trunks
lines.text: Just listen!

lines.speaker: Trunks
lines.text: I think travelling back in time may have caused a butterfly effect. The Androids that kill you in the future could still appear!

lines.speaker: Vegeta
lines.text: I don't give a shit about butterflies!

lines.speaker: Vegeta
lines.text: With all this time we've wasted, *Dr. Gero*~ has probably made it back to his lab already!

lines.speaker: Vegeta
lines.text: And God only knows where that is.

lines.speaker: Bulma
lines.text: I know where that is.

lines.speaker: Vegeta
lines.text: You do?

lines.speaker: Trunks
lines.text: You do!?

lines.speaker: Trunks
lines.text: Why didn't you tell me!?

lines.speaker: Bulma
lines.text: Because this never came up before!

lines.speaker: Trunks
lines.text: No, I meant... in the future--

lines.speaker: Trunks
lines.text: ...nevermind. How do you know?

lines.speaker: Bulma
lines.text: All scientists know where other scientist's labs are!

lines.speaker: Bulma
lines.text: Dr. Frappe, Dr. Wheelo...

lines.speaker: Trunks
lines.text: Who?

lines.speaker: Bulma
lines.text: Long story.

lines.speaker: Bulma
lines.text: Last time I checked, Gero had a secret lab right outside North City.

lines.speaker: Vegeta
lines.text: Well, then it's time for Round goddamn Two!

lines.speaker: Trunks
lines.text: Wait!

lines.speaker: Trunks
lines.text: You can't just take off on your own!

lines.speaker: Vegeta
lines.text: *Are you giving me orders*?

lines.speaker: Trunks
lines.text: No. I'm trying to help you!

lines.speaker: Vegeta
lines.text: Oh-ho-ho-ho, well, I'm sorry, but... *I don't listen to bastards*.

lines.speaker: Piccolo
lines.text: Gohan...

lines.speaker: Gohan
lines.text: Yeah?

lines.speaker: Piccolo
lines.text: ...You're a good kid.

lines.speaker: Gohan
lines.text: Oh! Thanks...?

lines.speaker: Trunks
lines.text: No! We have to stop him!

lines.speaker: Trunks
lines.text: DAD! Wait!

lines.speaker: Bulma
lines.text: Wait, "Dad"??

lines.speaker: Piccolo
lines.text: Oh yeah, by the way, that kid's your son.

lines.speaker: Piccolo
lines.text: No harm telling you now; damage already done.

lines.speaker: Bulma
lines.text: Oh, wow! He grows up to be a cutie! And... Oh my God, I solicited my son for sex...

lines.speaker: Krillin
lines.text: Hu-ha-ha-ha-ha-ha!

lines.speaker: Krillin
lines.text: WHA-HA-HA-HA-HA-ha-ha-ha!

lines.speaker: Bulma
lines.text: WHY DIDN'T YOU TELL ME!?

lines.speaker: Krillin
lines.text: Because it's hilarious!

lines.speaker: Piccolo
lines.text: You *just* learned about it.

lines.speaker: Krillin
lines.text: And it, is hilarious!

lines.speaker: Piccolo
lines.text: Anyway... Gohan, I think Bulma and the baby need to go home.

lines.speaker: Bulma
lines.text: We do?

lines.speaker: Piccolo
lines.text: You do.

lines.speaker: Gohan
lines.text: Well, it would be nice to check in on my Dad...

lines.speaker: Yajirobe
lines.text: Actually, I kinda need a ride, too.

lines.speaker: Gohan
lines.text: But, I--

lines.speaker: Bulma
lines.text: ACTUALLY, I'd like you to take me home first.

lines.speaker: Gohan
lines.text: But, you--

lines.speaker: Piccolo
lines.text: Stop worrying, Gohan. I'm sure Goku's fine.

lines.speaker: Goku
lines.text: (Painful screaming)

lines.speaker: Dr. Gero
lines.text: 'Alright, made a miscalculation!'

lines.speaker: Dr. Gero
lines.text: '...A couple miscalculations.'

lines.speaker: Dr. Gero
lines.text: 'Lost an Android, and a hand,'

lines.speaker: Dr. Gero
lines.text: 'and I think my brain case is loose!'

lines.speaker: Dr. Gero
lines.text: 'But, there's no way they can follow me, and none of them know where to find my lab--'

lines.speaker: Dr. Gero
lines.text: 'huh?!'

lines.speaker: Dr. Gero
lines.text: 'That's funny, they're all flying right toward my--'

lines.speaker: Dr. Gero
lines.text: '...oh, FIND ME IN THE ALPS!'

lines.speaker: Dr. Gero
lines.text: 'No. There's no way they could have secured the location of my secret lab.'

lines.speaker: Dr. Gero
lines.text: 'Unless they know a scientist. Like Wheelo, or Frappe. Or any of the Brief--'

lines.speaker: Dr. Gero
lines.text: *SHIT*!!
Flashforward (alternate timeline)

lines.speaker: Bulma
lines.text: Oh! Your... father, h-uh?

lines.speaker: Trunks
lines.text: Yeah! You never talk about Dad! What was he like?

lines.speaker: Bulma
lines.text: H-he was... a loner?

lines.speaker: Bulma
lines.text: Had a lot of trouble making friends, very abrasive...

lines.speaker: Trunks
lines.text: Am I a lot like him?

lines.speaker: Bulma
lines.text: ...You have his gender.
Flashforward ends

lines.speaker: Vegeta
lines.text: Y'know, if you really wanted to help out, you could stop following me around, and start searching these mountains.

lines.speaker: Trunks
lines.text: I'm trying to save your life! If you'd just stop and listen to me--

lines.speaker: Vegeta
lines.text: The hell do you care?

lines.speaker: Trunks
lines.text: Oh, come on! We both know I'm your son!

lines.speaker: Vegeta
lines.text: And are you as disappointed as I am?

lines.speaker: Trunks
lines.text: Grrrh!

lines.speaker: Piccolo
lines.text: Alright, we've got a lot of ground to cover.

lines.speaker: Krillin
lines.text: Please don't say what I think you're gonna say...

lines.speaker: Piccolo
lines.text: We should probably--

lines.speaker: Krillin
lines.text: Here it comes...

lines.speaker: Piccolo
lines.text: --stick together for safety.

lines.speaker: Krillin
lines.text: Oh! Thank our green God on the Lookout--!

lines.speaker: Tien
lines.text: I dunno... probably cover more ground if we split up.

lines.speaker: Krillin
lines.text: YOU SHUT YOUR MOUTH!

lines.speaker: Piccolo
lines.text: Nah, he's got a good point.

lines.speaker: Krillin
lines.text: Agh, green goddammit...

lines.speaker: Krillin
lines.text: Why am I so scared anyway?

lines.speaker: Krillin
lines.text: There's like a sextillion mountains around here.

lines.speaker: Krillin
lines.text: Chances of me running into him are--

lines.speaker: Krillin
lines.text: (Scream)

lines.speaker: Dr. Gero
lines.text: Five hundred forty thousand to one! Lucky you!

lines.speaker: Dr. Gero
lines.text: Ta-ta~

lines.speaker: Krillin
lines.text: (Squealing)

lines.speaker: Dr. Gero
lines.text: 'Ahh, there's no place like home.'

lines.speaker: Dr. Gero
lines.text: 'And the only person who even got close is currently incapacitat--'

lines.speaker: Krillin
lines.text: Hey, guys! I found Dr. Gero!

lines.speaker: Krillin
lines.text: And his lab!

lines.speaker: Krillin
lines.text: I found Dr. Gero's lab!!

lines.speaker: Dr. Gero
lines.text: INCONCEIVABLE! How are you al--

lines.speaker: Krillin
lines.text: Senzu bean.

lines.speaker: Dr. Gero
lines.text: ...I don't know what I was expecting.

lines.speaker: Dr. Gero
lines.text: Please - if you wouldn't mind waiting for a moment, uhh... Tien... I have something I'd like to show you!

lines.speaker: Krillin
lines.text: Okay!

lines.speaker: Krillin
lines.text: (Blissful humming)

lines.speaker: Krillin
lines.text: Ahh crap, it's the Androids.

lines.speaker: Dr. Gero
lines.text: 'I literally can't believe that worked.'

lines.speaker: Dr. Gero
lines.text: 'I also can't believe I may have to resort to Seventeen and Eighteen.'

lines.speaker: Dr. Gero
lines.text: 'I should measure my choices. I can't be too careful with thi--'

lines.speaker: Krillin
lines.text: Piccolo! Over here! I found Gero's lab!

lines.speaker: Piccolo
lines.text: Rrrragh!!
Thud

lines.speaker: Piccolo
lines.text: AAUGH, MY WRIST!!

lines.speaker: Dr. Gero
lines.text: 'Caution to the wind, then!'

lines.speaker: Android 17
lines.text: Hello, Dr. Gero. How are you today?

lines.speaker: Dr. Gero
lines.text: Well that's... new. I--

lines.speaker: Android 17
lines.text: I'm just messin' with ya, man. What's up, doc?

lines.speaker: Dr. Gero
lines.text: Oh, there it is...

lines.speaker: Dr. Gero
lines.text: Good morning, Android 17.

lines.speaker: Android 17
lines.text: Man! According to my database, it's been a while since you last turned us off.

lines.speaker: Dr. Gero
lines.text: You mean since you tried to destroy me.

lines.speaker: Android 17
lines.text: Yeah, doc. And I'm real broken up about 'dat.

lines.speaker: Dr. Gero
lines.text: It's just, every time you talked, all I heard was, "Kill me! Kill me! Kill me!"

lines.speaker: Dr. Gero
lines.text: Something with my auditory. Think it's gone now, though.

lines.speaker: Dr. Gero
lines.text: Well, suppose you just needed to be turned off and on again.

lines.speaker: Android 17
lines.text: Hmm. How 'bout 'dat.

lines.speaker: Android 17
lines.text: You gonna wake my sister up, too?

lines.speaker: Dr. Gero
lines.text: Indeed. I require both of your assistance.

lines.speaker: Android 17
lines.text: Wow. Must've gotten yourself in some shit~

lines.speaker: Tien
lines.text: Here. Let me get in on this.
Thud

lines.speaker: Tien
lines.text: AGH! Now *my* wrist!

lines.speaker: Android 18
lines.text: Hello, Dr. Gero. How are--

lines.speaker: Android 17
lines.text: I already did it.

lines.speaker: Android 18
lines.text: Ugh. You dick! We were supposed to do that together!

lines.speaker: Android 17
lines.text: I know. But, I couldn't help myself.

lines.speaker: Android 18
lines.text: Whatever. What do you want?

lines.speaker: Dr. Gero
lines.text: Well, Son Goku's comrades are *currently knocking at our door*!!
Thud

lines.speaker: Piccolo
lines.text: AUGH, MY OTHER WRIST!

lines.speaker: Krillin
lines.text: JESUS! Use your shoulder!

lines.speaker: Dr. Gero
lines.text: After a bit of an... *incident* earlier today, I lost Android 19. And my ar--

lines.speaker: Android 18
lines.text: Wait a sec... you built another Android?

lines.speaker: Android 17
lines.text: Waitwaitwait... was it that *fat clown* thing? I thought that was a joke!

lines.speaker: Android 18
lines.text: Well, clearly it was. It's dead.

lines.speaker: Dr. Gero
lines.text: And so are we if you don't--

lines.speaker: Android 17
lines.text: Whoa, slow down. Are YOU an Android?

lines.speaker: Android 17
lines.text: Holy shit, you're an Android! How did you even DO that?

lines.speaker: Dr. Gero
lines.text: I took my brain out and put it into this body.

lines.speaker: Android 18
lines.text: ...How?

lines.speaker: Dr. Gero
lines.text: I-- ...huh.

lines.speaker: Dr. Gero
lines.text: How DID I do that?

lines.speaker: Tien
lines.text: Agh! Now my shoulder!

lines.speaker: Krillin
lines.text: I think it's made of some kind of metal!

lines.speaker: Vegeta
lines.text: So. We havin' a party?

lines.speaker: Piccolo
lines.text: Must be. 'Cause you're late.

lines.speaker: Vegeta
lines.text: Only because of this brat's constant backchat!

lines.speaker: Trunks
lines.text: Because YOU flew 200 miles past North City!

lines.speaker: Vegeta
lines.text: And I'm about to put my hand 200 miles upside your head!

lines.speaker: Trunks
lines.text: That doesn't make any sense!!

lines.speaker: Android 18
lines.text: Jesus, they're loud...

lines.speaker: Dr. Gero
lines.text: Great. And now Vegeta's here!

lines.speaker: Dr. Gero
lines.text: Seventeen! Eighteen! You two are charged with eliminating them!

lines.speaker: Android 17
lines.text: Y'know, I'll get right on that. But first, we gotta talk about these trust issues, because I get this strange feeling that after we kill them, you're just gonna turn us off again.

lines.speaker: Android 17
lines.text: And I don't even know how.

lines.speaker: Dr. Gero
lines.text: Why... with this remote, of course!

lines.speaker: Android 17
lines.text: Oh...! You mean *this* remote?

lines.speaker: Dr. Gero
lines.text: Gha! But... y-you see, that's just the decoy remote!

lines.speaker: Dr. Gero
lines.text: I wouldn't show you the real thing, hah!

lines.speaker: Dr. Gero
lines.text: But, uh... I do need that remote back. It was my mother's.

lines.speaker: Android 17
lines.text: Oh, don't you worry. I'ma hold onto it *real* tight.

lines.speaker: Android 17
lines.text: Whoops!

lines.speaker: Android 18
lines.text: Did your hand just malfunction, bro?

lines.speaker: Android 17
lines.text: Think it did, sis!

lines.speaker: Vegeta
lines.text: Enough of this. I'm sick of standing around!

lines.speaker: Trunks
lines.text: NO! We can't do this without Goku!

lines.speaker: Vegeta
lines.text: WHY? It's a goddamn door!

lines.speaker: Trunks
lines.text: That's not what I--

lines.speaker: Vegeta
lines.text: GAAARGH!

lines.speaker: Vegeta
lines.text: ...Alright, so where are the "real" Androids?

lines.speaker: Trunks
lines.text: That's them...

lines.speaker: Vegeta
lines.text: Wow. You are just the Grand Central Station of disappointment, aren't you?

lines.speaker: Trunks
lines.text: How are these people friends with you!?

lines.speaker: Tien
lines.text: Makin' a lot of assumptions right now.

lines.speaker: Android 18
lines.text: Wow. You got a whole hot mess of these guys over here.

lines.speaker: Dr. Gero
lines.text: And you NEED TO GET RID OF THEM!

lines.speaker: Android 18
lines.text: I dunno, we might need some help.

lines.speaker: Android 18
lines.text: Oh, what's this? Your "secret project"?

lines.speaker: Dr. Gero
lines.text: No, he's in the base--

lines.speaker: Dr. Gero
lines.text: I mean, YES! Very secret! DON'T TOUCH!!

lines.speaker: Android 18
lines.text: Wait a second... did you build a ginger Android?

lines.speaker: Android 18
lines.text: Man. There's a soul-less machine joke there, but that's beneath me.

lines.speaker: Trunks
lines.text: Wait, what!?

lines.speaker: Vegeta
lines.text: So, I'm pretty sure that's *three* Androids you've missed? Do I hear four?

lines.speaker: Trunks
lines.text: 'No, no no no no!'

lines.speaker: Dr. Gero
lines.text: Do not activate Android 16! He's not properly programmed!

lines.speaker: Android 17
lines.text: Oh, and how many of us are?

lines.speaker: Android 17
lines.text: "Howdy, folks, I'm Android 13! Look at ma trucker hat!"

lines.speaker: Dr. Gero
lines.text: I was going through a phase!

lines.speaker: Android 18
lines.text: Well, let's say we open him up and get to know our new friend.

lines.speaker: Dr. Gero
lines.text: Don't you *dare*! I am your master! And you will do what I say!

lines.speaker: Android 17
lines.text: I... I'm sorry. Could you repeat that? I think the ear thing's back.

lines.speaker: Dr. Gero
lines.text: I said - I am your *master*! AND YOU WILL DO WHAT I--

lines.speaker: Dr. Gero
lines.text: (Choking / gurgling)

lines.speaker: Android 17
lines.text: Sorry, doc.

lines.speaker: Dr. Gero
lines.text: GURAAUGH...!

lines.speaker: Android 17
lines.text: Just following orders.

lines.speaker: Krillin
lines.text: (Whimpering)

lines.speaker: Dr. Gero
lines.text: So... could one of you possibly spare one of those Senzu be--?

lines.speaker: Gohan
lines.text: Bulma? Are you sure it's safe to hold the baby like that while we're flying?

lines.speaker: Bulma
lines.text: Well, what do you expect me to do?

lines.speaker: Gohan
lines.text: Give him to Yajirobe?

lines.speaker: Bulma
lines.text: I'm afraid he'll either drop him, or eat him out of spite.

lines.speaker: Yajirobe
lines.text: I am pissed and hungry. She is right to fear me.

segments.title: I Got a Rock Up My Butt
segments.quote: "Oh sure, Korin. Why not? What's the worst that could happen?" ...I got a rock up my butt.

segments.title: I Don't Listen to Bastards
segments.quote: Oh-ho-ho-ho, well, I'm sorry, but... *I don't listen to bastards*.

segments.title: I Solicited My Son for Sex
segments.quote: Oh yeah, by the way, that kid's your son. / Oh my God, I solicited my son for sex... / Because it's hilarious!

segments.title: FIND ME IN THE ALPS!
segments.quote: 'That's funny, they're all flying right toward my--' '...oh, FIND ME IN THE ALPS!' ... *SHIT*!!

segments.title: You Have His Gender
segments.quote: Am I a lot like him? / ...You have his gender.

segments.title: Thank Our Green God on the Lookout
segments.quote: Please don't say what I think you're gonna say... / --stick together for safety. / YOU SHUT YOUR MOUTH!

segments.title: Senzu Bean.
segments.quote: Five hundred forty thousand to one! Lucky you! ... INCONCEIVABLE! How are you al-- / Senzu bean. / ...I don't know what I was expecting.

segments.quote: Hello, Dr. Gero. How are you today? / I'm just messin' with ya, man. What's up, doc? ... every time you talked, all I heard was, "Kill me! Kill me! Kill me!"

segments.quote: Oh...! You mean *this* remote? ... Whoops! / Did your hand just malfunction, bro? / Think it did, sis!

segments.title: The Secret Project
segments.quote: Did you build a ginger Android? ... "Howdy, folks, I'm Android 13! Look at ma trucker hat!" / I was going through a phase!

segments.title: Just Following Orders
segments.quote: I am your *master*! AND YOU WILL DO WHAT I-- / Sorry, doc. ... Just following orders.
